rows.title: Chronic kidney disease - Symptoms and causes - Mayo Clinic
rows.description: Chronic kidney disease happens when the kidneys are damaged for more than a few months. The kidneys clean the blood by removing waste and extra fluid, which leaves the body as urine. They help control blood pressure and balance salt and minerals. The kidneys also help the body make red blood cells and keep bones strong.

rows.title: People with kidney disease should be cautious with supplements, Mayo ...
rows.description: In all people, but especially among those with kidney disease, supplements may cause acute kidney injury or intensify the long-term deterioration of kidney function. rows.title: Kidney stones - Symptoms and causes - Mayo Clinic
rows.description: Kidney stones are hard objects made of minerals and salts in urine. They form inside the kidneys. You may hear healthcare professionals refer to kidney stones as renal calculi, nephrolithiasis or urolithiasis. Kidney stones have various causes. These include diet, extra body weight, some health conditions, and some supplements and medicines.
